verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses data retention policies, deletion controls, or privacy/GDPR-style data management settings for AI-native usage; the pack covers CRM APIs, MCP servers, and general product features but nothing about controlling data retention or deletion. Missing for 10: documentation of data retention settings, deletion/erasure APIs or workflows, GDPR/CCPA compliance controls, and any AI-specific data handling/retention policy.
